name: get_redot_scene_tree
description: Read the Redot/Godot scene tree reported by an owned launch's loopback engine-debugger protocol peer. Results identify their cooperative protocol source and are paged.

refresh.description: Ask the responsive engine for a fresh tree before a later poll.

name: inspect_redot_object
description: Select a Redot/Godot scene object and read its engine-reported script, properties, and Signal-valued properties. Object IDs may be decimal strings to preserve 64-bit values.
